chunks.content: ## Overview of CLO 2025.2 Version Generator Updates This section introduces the CLO 2025.2 version generator, highlighting the addition of pants and a group of products beyond T-shirts. It explains the dual approach for creating versions: using measured size data or AI-generated data, enabling diversified clothing version creation efficiently. --- ## Creating Versions by Inputting Measured Values This section details how to create clothing versions by manually inputting measured values, focusing on pants and skirts using the version generator interface. ### Accessing the Version Generator and Available Presets - Open the virtual model in CLO. - Navigate to the main menu bar, select 2D, and open the version generator. - Newly added presets include pants (gold waist pants, leisure pants) and a group of products (round skirt, A skirt). ### Inputting Control Part Sizes - Select pants and leisure pants as the product. - Use **Simple Mode** for initial size adjustments; control parts appear at the bottom of the interface. - Switch to **Regular Mode** for detailed parameter input and modification. - Parameters include activation (directly input values) and stop parameters (automatically calculated based on measured data). ### Saving and Adjusting Key Measurements - The version generator uses waist and hip width to create a "saving" (ease allowance). - Only the saving number can be input manually; distances and lengths are auto-calculated but can be unlocked by toggling the connection icon. - Example workflow: - Input saving values. - Adjust front pocket measurements. - Save settings and close the save function. ### Waist, Hip, and Length Adjustments - Total length input can be enabled/disabled to assign front and back piece lengths automatically or manually. - Calculator access is provided within input boxes for convenience. - Example values: - Waist and hip total length set to 750 mm or 1000 mm. - Ankle total length adjusted to 500 mm. - Adjustments to thigh and crotch widths happen automatically based on related inputs. ### Back Crotch and Waist Modifications - Back crotch length and province (dart) number can be adjusted (e.g., province changed from two to one). - Waist width and height can be modified to better fit the body (example: waist width set to 730 mm when waist circumference is 750 mm; height set to 40 mm). ### Switching to Regular Mode for Detailed Control - Regular mode allows modification of parameters like thigh width and dart specifics not available in simple mode. - Example: Back crotch thigh width set to 320 mm; dart length adjusted to 130 mm. - Connection toggles enable or disable automatic parameter linking. ### Saving and Loading Version Data - Completed version data can be saved as a CSV file. - Future operations can reuse saved CSV by loading it, avoiding manual re-entry. - Current version generator only supports CSV for import/export. ### Creating and Verifying the Version - After inputting all values, click "Create" in the lower right corner. - Use the 2D window's left button to finalize version creation.
chunks.content_description: CLO2025.2 introduces a new pattern generator that allows you to quickly create pants and skirt patterns by simply uploading an image or entering a description, so your inspiration never stalls and efficiency is maximized.

Current version generator only supports CSV for import/export. ### Creating and Verifying the Version - After inputting all values, click "Create" in the lower right corner. - Use the 2D window's left button to finalize version creation. - Verify arrangement and sewing completion in the 3D simulation window, confirming automatic placement based on the virtual model. --- ## AI Version Generator for Creative Version Creation This section explains how to use the AI version generator to create clothing versions from prompts or reference images, streamlining creative visualization. ### Accessing and Using AI Version Generator - Click the AI version generator icon in the upper right of the version generator window. - Two input methods: - **Prompt Option Card:** Enter descriptive keywords or select from suggestions. - **Image Option Card:** Upload reference images for style guidance. ### Generating Versions with AI - Select product type (e.g., half a group A skirt). - Enter or choose keywords, then start generation. - After generation, click the button to convert the generated image to a version. - Control parts auto-fill based on AI-generated outlines. ### Current Limitations and Adjustments - AI-generated versions capture the general outline but omit details like zippers, door handles, or pockets. - Future updates aim to improve detail recognition. - Users can refine AI-generated versions manually in the version generator. ### Using the Image Option Card - Upload a reference image for an umbrella group skirt. - AI uses the image for version generation. - After generation, users can adjust control parts like waist length, hip width, and bottom width. ### Example Adjustments After AI Generation - Waist total length set to 650 mm. - Hip width adjusted to 900 mm. - Bottom width adjusted to 870 mm. - Symmetry adjustments made for front and back groups. - Waist plate can be removed or modified as needed. ### Detailed Parameter Controls - Display all measurements and hidden parameters on the right side of the module. - Activate detailed controls (e.g., middle gap adjustments) via the detailed information icon. - Enables precise version customization beyond basic AI generation. ### Finalizing AI-Generated Versions - Click "Create" to generate the version with adjustments. - Close the version generator window. - Verify fit and arrangement in the 3D simulation window. --- ## Summary of CLO 2025.2 Version Generator Capabilities - Expanded support to include pants and shorts alongside existing T-shirt versions. - Two main workflows: - Manual input of measured sizes for precise version creation. - AI-assisted generation for rapid creative visualization. - Features include automatic sewing and arrangement based on virtual models. - CSV import/export for version data reuse. - Calculator integration within input fields for precise measurements. - Adjustable parameters at both simple and detailed levels.
